title: Gymnasium Environments
learning_objectives: Write an environment as a gymnasium.Env subclass with observation and action spaces
Use the seeded self.np_random generator through super().reset(seed=seed)
Add a time limit with the TimeLimit wrapper and validate the environment with check_env
hints: Validate the arguments, then create the two `spaces.Discrete` objects.
`self.action_space.contains(action)` checks the action; draw the slip with `self.np_random.random()`.
`min(max(self.state + step, 0), self.n - 1)` keeps the state on the line.

failure_feedback.advice: Subclass gym.Env, define both spaces and return (obs, info) from reset.
Wrap the environment with TimeLimit(env, max_episode_steps=max_steps).
Call super().reset(seed=seed) and draw slips from self.np_random.
Validate the constructor arguments and reject actions outside the action space.
